summary.zh: 围绕一个指标反复尝试，只留更优结果
summary.en: Iterate edits against one metric and keep only the wins.

description.zh: 把“让文件变好”拆成可测量的试验：改一处、跑固定评测、保留提升、回退退步，循环多轮。适合优化代码速度、打包体积、通过率或提示词得分。需要先有一个可以无人值守运行的评测命令。
description.en: Turns making a file better into a measured loop: edit one place, run a fixed evaluation, keep improvements, revert regressions. Use it for speed, bundle size, pass rate or prompt score. Needs an eval command that runs unattended.
